note: /tree and /resume <id> with a SessionStart hook that waits 11 s or 15 s: the old session's SessionEnd other arrives before the new SessionStart in 124 of 124 switches while the droid process stays alive. Only the captures with a delay past 10 s are kept (tree-d15000 on both versions, resume-d15000, tree-d11000, tree-d11000a). Session ids are S1/S2 relations and the process is P1; the replay assigns a synthetic pid per process. No prompt, path, pid or key is in the rows.
clock: rows are in the order the probe listener or logger recorded them
